description: The project's recorded Ubiquitous Language: Entities (with optional Aggregate designations), Value Objects, Business Rules, and Domain Events. ArcLint owns the concept meanings; the project supplies names, definitions, and aliases. Unknown keys are rejected everywhere.

business_rules.description: A statement the project requires to always or never be true about its domain.

items.description: A statement the project requires to always or never be true about its domain.

aliases.description: Other names the project uses for this Business Rule.

definition.description: Meaning of this Business Rule in the project's Ubiquitous Language.

name.description: Canonical project name for this Business Rule.

entities.description: A domain concept whose identity matters as it changes over time.

items.description: A domain concept whose identity matters as it changes over time.

aggregate.description: An Entity the project treats as a consistency boundary: it is changed as one unit and other objects reach it through its identity.

aliases.description: Other names the project uses for this Entity.

definition.description: Meaning of this Entity in the project's Ubiquitous Language.

name.description: Canonical project name for this Entity.

events.description: Something that has completed in the domain and that the project cares to record.

items.description: Something that has completed in the domain and that the project cares to record.

aliases.description: Other names the project uses for this Domain Event.

definition.description: Meaning of this Domain Event in the project's Ubiquitous Language.

name.description: Canonical project name for this Domain Event.

value_objects.description: A domain value defined entirely by its attributes, with no identity of its own.

items.description: A domain value defined entirely by its attributes, with no identity of its own.

aliases.description: Other names the project uses for this Value Object.

definition.description: Meaning of this Value Object in the project's Ubiquitous Language.

name.description: Canonical project name for this Value Object.

version.description: Document version. This arclint accepts version 1 only.
